text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's challenge in the Twinkle 
Series begins. However, she harbored the 
lingering risk of having fragile legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to other Umamusume, her legs are 
underdeveloped. Even a training load or 
intensity that an ordinary girl could 
withstand carries the risk of causing an 
injury to her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her classmates, Narita Brian and Hishi 
Amazon, have already begun rigorous 
running. Naturally, Sakura Laurel would 
fall behind, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel doesn't despair over her 
situation. Even with a handicap in her 
legs, she smiles brightly, saying she 
still has every right to chase her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to take on the Classic Triple 
Crown. And someday, the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe— Sakura Laurel's challenge toward 
her dream has begun.
